exact_remaining_blocker.summary: persist_unresolved_send/attach_send_result/clear_unresolved_send mutate SERVICE_STATE_FILE via independent reload/write, but the active DryRunLiveCopyService retains an older self.state. process_ws_fill and run_once call self.persist() after process_fill, rewriting SERVICE_STATE_FILE from stale self.state and potentially erasing in_flight_unresolved and settlement checkpoint updates created during the send.
evidence: manual_send_one_intent persists unresolved send before send_hyperliquid_order using persist_unresolved_send().
persist_unresolved_send writes SERVICE_STATE_FILE through _state_write(), not through the active service object's self.state.
process_ws_fill calls self.process_fill(fill,cfg) and then self.persist().
run_once processes fills then calls self.persist().
persist() writes SERVICE_STATE_FILE from self.state without merging current on-disk in_flight_unresolved.
Therefore any unresolved/partial/unknown real-send reservation written during process_fill can be clobbered before crash/restart recovery relies on it.
exact_remaining_blocker.impact: A real order may remain unsettled while the durable blocker is erased. Restart can then load no unresolved reservation and re-authorise overlapping/duplicate exposure, violating G3 IN_FLIGHT_RECOVERY_RULE and SETTLEMENT_LIFECYCLE_RULE.
